OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope of the connector, e.g. 'indicator, vulnerability'.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector. Prefer ISO-8601 (e.g. PT24H). Legacy RST_THREAT_FEED_INTERVAL (seconds) is still accepted and mapped here.

CONNECTOR_QUEUE_THRESHOLD.description: Server capacity: max RabbitMQ queue size (in MB) before the connector pauses ingestion. Surfaced in the OpenCTI UI.

CONNECTOR_UPDATE_EXISTING_DATA.description: Whether to update existing STIX objects in OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_AUTO_CREATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT.description: Create a dedicated Connectors-group service account for this connector on first start and run subsequent API calls as that user.

CONNECTOR_AUTO_CREATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_CO.description: Max confidence level for the auto-created connector service account.

RST_THREAT_FEED_APIKEY.description: RST Cloud Threat Feed API key.

RST_THREAT_FEED_READTIMEOUT.description: HTTP read timeout in seconds for feed downloads.

RST_THREAT_FEED_RETRY.description: Per-request HTTP retry count for feed downloads.

RST_THREAT_FEED_SSL_VERIFY.description: Verify TLS certificates for API requests.

RST_THREAT_FEED_PROXY.description: Optional explicit forward proxy URL for feed downloads. When empty (default), requests honor standard HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, and NO_PROXY environment variables.

RST_THREAT_FEED_LATEST.description: Which feed snapshot window to download.

RST_THREAT_FEED_INTERVAL.description: Deprecated. Run interval in seconds. Prefer CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD. When set, overrides duration_period.

RST_THREAT_FEED_MIN_SCORE_IMPORT.description: Import only indicators with total score at or above this value.

RST_THREAT_FEED_MIN_SCORE_DETECTION_IP.description: Score threshold for x_opencti_detection on IPv4 indicators.

RST_THREAT_FEED_MIN_SCORE_DETECTION_DOMA.description: Score threshold for x_opencti_detection on Domain indicators.

RST_THREAT_FEED_MIN_SCORE_DETECTION_URL.description: Score threshold for x_opencti_detection on URL indicators.

RST_THREAT_FEED_MIN_SCORE_DETECTION_HASH.description: Score threshold for x_opencti_detection on Hash indicators.

RST_THREAT_FEED_ONLY_NEW.description: Skip indicators whose last-seen is older than the collect window.

RST_THREAT_FEED_ONLY_ATTRIBUTED.description: Import only indicators attributed to known threats.

RST_THREAT_FEED_CREATE_MITRE_TTPS.description: Create Attack-Pattern objects for MITRE TTP IDs and relate them to indicators. Can produce a large number of relationships.

RST_THREAT_FEED_CREATE_CUSTOM_TTPS.description: Create custom Attack-Pattern objects for named techniques not yet covered by MITRE ATT&CK.

RST_THREAT_FEED_MAX_RETRIES.description: Maximum attempts when pushing bundles to OpenCTI.

RST_THREAT_FEED_RETRY_DELAY.description: Initial retry delay in seconds for OpenCTI push failures. The connector sleeps at least 1 second between retries.

RST_THREAT_FEED_RETRY_BACKOFF_MULTIPLIER.description: Exponential backoff multiplier for OpenCTI push retries.

RST_THREAT_FEED_OPENCTI_BATCH_SIZE.description: Max STIX objects per OpenCTI push. Large feeds (especially Domain) are flushed in chunks to bound memory and avoid oversized works.
